values.title: Excellence at Every Stage
values.subtitle: From first contact to your first game on American soil, we handle the complexity so you can focus on your sport.
values.strategic_desc: We pair your athletic and academic profile with the right programs, not just any program.
values.eligibility_desc: Navigate NCAA and NAIA eligibility with confidence. We track every requirement.
values.guidance_desc: Dedicated advisors who understand international recruitment from every angle.
values.academic_desc: Transcript evaluation, SAT/ACT prep guidance, and academic eligibility tracking.

process.title: Five Steps to Your Future
process.subtitle: A clear, structured path from where you are to where you want to be.
process.step1_desc: Create your account and fill in your athletic, academic, and personal details.
process.step2_desc: Our team reviews your profile and schedules your first discovery call.
process.step3_desc: Share your best game footage and we build your recruitment package.
process.step4_desc: We connect you with the right coaches and programs for your goals.
process.step5_desc: Secure your offer, handle paperwork, and prepare for your journey.

stories.title: Athletes Who Made It
stories.mathis_quote: I contacted N10 to handle my transfer and everything went really well. They helped me settle into my new life, and my student-athlete journey is going very well.
stories.naim_quote: An overwhelmingly positive experience. N10 helped me achieve my sports and academic goals while supporting and advising me throughout the year.
stories.samy_mom_quote: Yes, I am very satisfied with N10's services and I highly recommend them.
stories.naim_dad_quote1: Honestly, as parents, we loved the N10 experience! It was a wonderful adventure for Naim in his first year. We saw him make huge progress in training, while also gaining a great deal of maturity and independence.
stories.naim_dad_quote2_and_3:
As for the departure and getting everything set up, the support completely lived up to our expectations. We had some initial apprehension (which is normal for parents!), but N10 was incredibly reassuring. Everything was clear, well organized, and completely smooth, which allowed us to approve the move with total confidence.

The support throughout the season was truly excellent. We really appreciated N10's availability and the fact that the human and mental side were given as much consideration as technique and physical preparation on the court.
stories.naim_dad_quote4: During the transfer period, which is always a little stressful, we felt very well supported. The advice was professional, transparent, and always focused on what was best for Naim's future. A huge thank you to N10.
stories.mohamed_quote1: I think N10 is a great agency. It helped me a lot throughout the whole process, from finding the right school for me to helping with the paperwork and everything I needed. The agency made the whole process much easier for me.
stories.mohamed_quote2: The process was pretty smooth with N10's assistance. N10 guided me through every step and made sure I had everything ready before coming to the USA.
stories.mohamed_quote3: The integration at school and with the volleyball team was really easy. Everyone welcomed me with open arms, and I felt comfortable from the beginning. N10 also helped make the transition easier for me.
stories.mohamed_quote4: Of course! I would definitely recommend N10 to any athlete who wants to study and play in the USA. If you have the talent and motivation, the agency can help make that opportunity happen and guide you through the whole process.
